entries.label: Dite — périmètre de défense finale
entries.scene: The actual Chapter 24 final defense site in Metal Gear Survive, as seen in the reference sheets. Dry dusty reddish-tan African ground with pale grass tufts, low rocky ridges, sparse acacia silhouettes, rough temporary chain-link fence segments and simple low makeshift defensive barriers, thin skeletal bent metal arch structures. Include the small dark angular mission defense apparatus on its compact base as shown in the separate reference frame, placed behind the combat lane, and faint horizontal glowing red oval wormhole rings above the distant ridges. Preserve the open overcast dusty daylight, low buildings far behind and flat rough dirt foreground. OMIT the enormous Lord of Dust creature and every person, creature and combat explosion. This is a representative final defense perimeter; do not invent a fixed elaborate base layout, large sci-fi reactor or futuristic fortress.
entries.prompt: Create exactly ONE opaque wide 16:9 static fighting-game stage background plate for CQC, closely grounded in the supplied original PSP/game screenshots. Input images are REFERENCE SCREENSHOTS or chronological reference contact sheets only. Output one continuous environment, never a grid or collage. Ignore all characters, menus, HUD, cards, facecam, video branding and subtitles in the references. The actual Chapter 24 final defense site in Metal Gear Survive, as seen in the reference sheets. Dry dusty reddish-tan African ground with pale grass tufts, low rocky ridges, sparse acacia silhouettes, rough temporary chain-link fence segments and simple low makeshift defensive barriers, thin skeletal bent metal arch structures. Include the small dark angular mission defense apparatus on its compact base as shown in the separate reference frame, placed behind the combat lane, and faint horizontal glowing red oval wormhole rings above the distant ridges. Preserve the open overcast dusty daylight, low buildings far behind and flat rough dirt foreground. OMIT the enormous Lord of Dust creature and every person, creature and combat explosion. This is a representative final defense perimeter; do not invent a fixed elaborate base layout, large sci-fi reactor or futuristic fortress. Adapt the camera to human eye height facing sideways across a continuous clear level foreground combat lane in the lower fifth. Keep the reference materials, architecture and palette; no unreferenced redesign. No people, enemies, logos, UI, captions or watermark. Detailed faithful game-rendered environment.
